newsitem.title: USA: Rubin coy on plans but won't return to Wall Street.
newsitem.headline: Rubin coy on plans but won't return to Wall Street.

text.p: U.S. Treasury Secretary Robert Rubin on Friday ducked a question about whether he would stay on if President Clinton won a second term, although he did say he would not return to Wall Street.

"I'm not going back to Wall Street," the former Goldman Sachs executive told reporters after being asked about his future plans. Then, he added, "Wait until after the election, the president will make his decision."
Rubin is widely expected by administration insiders to remain Treasury chief if Clinton wins re-election November 5.
